title: Game window does not respect stretch mode of main viewport
body:
### Tested versions

Resizing works as it should in 4.3
Letterboxing instead in 4.4.1 and 4.5 dev4

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev4 - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - AMD Ryzen 5 5500 (12 threads); also tested on Nobara Linux on the same PC

### Issue description

I upgraded my project from Godot 4.3 to 4.4.1, and resizing the window doesn't work like it did before and I can't find a way to return the old functionality, which is cruical to my project.

On Godot 4.3, with the default settings, when resizing the game window, the viewport gets extended to the new window size. This is what I want my project to do:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3063dc66-c6eb-4cf1-9a43-442be28377f8)

On Godot 4.4+, importing the very same project that worked in 4.3, the viewport is now fixed in aspect ratio and doesn't extend.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/45dccc43-cd4b-4420-b617-7463b6328e54)

The project settings look the same for the two projects - Stretch mode is "disabled" and Aspect is "Keep". I've also tried all kinds of different combinations of these variables on 4.4.1, no matter what I do, it's always letterboxing.
I've tested the latest 4.5 dev4, the same problem is present there as well.



### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a project in Godot 4.3 with the default settings. Apply some kind of background for better visualization.
2. Test the project and try to resize the window. Notice the viewport extends, without letterboxes.
3. Import that same project into Godot 4.4.1 and upgrade it.
4. Test and resize the window - now it keeps its aspect ratio, introducing letterboxes.
5. Try all kinds of combinations of settings in Project Settings to bring back the old functionality - it's not working.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[BubblesTEST_4.3.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20256476/BubblesTEST_4.3.zip)
